description: This file implements security policy checks for Kubernetes pods, specifically enforcing restrictions on setting runAsUser to 0 in various Kubernetes versions.

methods.name: CheckRunAsUser
methods.description: Returns a check object that enforces restrictions on runAsUser for Kubernetes versions 1.23+ and 1.35+.

methods.name: runAsUser1_35
methods.description: Checks if runAsUser=0 is set in the pod spec for Kubernetes 1.35+ and applies relaxed policies if applicable.

methods.name: runAsUser1_23
methods.description: Checks if runAsUser=0 is explicitly set in the pod or containers for Kubernetes 1.23.
